in_marathi.name: Chandrakumar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrakumar is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Moon-powered'. In Hindu mythology, the moon is personified by the god Chandrasekhar, who is considered the god of the night and the ruler of the stars. The name Chandrakumar is a tribute to this celestial deity and signifies the power and grace of the moon.
